enhancedPrompt.productVision: To create a comprehensive UI design system called 'Layers' that enables educators, administrators, and policymakers to measure and improve student outcomes, system leadership, institutional effectiveness, and school-level improvements through a unified, data-driven framework.
enhancedPrompt.targetUsers: Educational administrators, school leaders, policymakers, teachers, and education-focused NGOs.
personas: School Principal: Needs to track student outcomes and school improvements, requires intuitive dashboards and reports.
District Education Officer: Focuses on system-level metrics, policy changes, and resource allocation across multiple schools.
Education NGO Program Manager: Monitors program impact, collaborates with government bodies, and ensures scalability of interventions.
coreFeatures: Dynamic Dashboard: Visualizes ERLAW, ALIVE, and PACE metrics with filters for different user roles.
Data Input Forms: Allows manual and bulk upload of student and system data.
Analytics Engine: Generates insights and trends from the collected data.
Collaboration Tools: Enables sharing of reports and coordination among stakeholders.
Custom Reporting: Users can create and export tailored reports based on selected indicators.
userStories: As a school principal, I want to view attendance and dropout rates so I can identify at-risk students.
As a district officer, I need to compare resource allocation across schools to ensure equitable distribution.
As an NGO manager, I want to track policy changes influenced by our programs to demonstrate impact.
As a teacher, I need to input student engagement data to contribute to holistic learning metrics.
As a system leader, I want to visualize improvement initiatives to assess their effectiveness.
pages: Home Dashboard: Overview of key metrics and quick access to reports.
Data Entry: Forms for inputting student, school, and system data.
Analytics: Detailed charts and tables for each framework (ERLAW, ALIVE, PACE).
Collaboration Hub: Shared workspace for stakeholders to discuss and plan.
userFlows: Principal logs in → views student retention dashboard → drills down to specific grade → exports report for staff meeting.
NGO manager uploads program data → system updates policy influence metrics → shares insights with government partners.
Teacher inputs daily attendance → data reflects in real-time on principal’s dashboard → triggers automated alerts for low attendance.
enhancedPrompt.architecture: Frontend: React.js with a responsive design. Backend: Node.js with Express. Database: PostgreSQL for relational data and MongoDB for unstructured data. API: RESTful endpoints for data exchange.
enhancedPrompt.database: PostgreSQL for structured data (student records, attendance). MongoDB for dynamic data (collaboration logs, unstructured reports). Redis for caching frequently accessed metrics.
uxRequirements: Intuitive navigation with role-based access control.
Data visualization that is easily interpretable with minimal training.
Mobile-responsive design for field data entry.
technicalRequirements: High concurrency handling for large school districts.
Data encryption for sensitive student information.
edgeCases: Offline data entry when internet is unavailable.
Handling incomplete or inconsistent data submissions.
Scaling for thousands of schools in a single district.
acceptanceCriteria: All framework metrics (ERLAW, ALIVE, PACE) are accurately captured and displayed.
Users can generate and export reports in at least two formats (PDF, Excel).
System handles concurrent users from multiple schools without performance degradation.
successMetrics: Adoption rate among target users (schools, districts, NGOs).
Reduction in time to generate and share reports.
Improvement in student outcomes as measured by the ERLAW framework.
risks: Low adoption due to resistance to new systems in traditional education settings.
Data privacy concerns with sensitive student information.
Inconsistent data quality from manual entries affecting analytics.

prd.title: Layers UI Design System PRD
prd.overview: Layers is a comprehensive UI design system that enables educators, administrators, and policymakers to measure and improve student outcomes, system leadership, institutional effectiveness, and school-level improvements through a unified, data-driven framework. It provides dynamic dashboards, data input forms, analytics engines, collaboration tools, and custom reporting to empower stakeholders in the education sector.
goals: Enable educators and administrators to track and improve student outcomes
Provide a unified framework for measuring system leadership and institutional effectiveness
Facilitate data-driven decision-making for school-level improvements
Enhance collaboration among stakeholders to implement scalable interventions
Offer customizable reporting tools for tailored insights
prd.targetAudience: Educational administrators, school leaders, policymakers, teachers, and education-focused NGOs
